notes: The second *in* was given to the written בְּ of the same coordination, whose English the ASV simply writes again over the coordinated member (rules 33 and 25); reading it as a supplied preposition on אֲפֵלָה was the competing analysis.
Each pair of *the*s is counted by the word it stands before, no article morpheme standing anywhere in the verse (rule 29).
The Hebrew gloss on אִישׁוֹן was read and set aside (rule 38).
